description: Get gambling regulatory context for a jurisdiction plus recent source-linked enforcement records. Jurisdictions resolve through WagerX's approved regulator registry; records whose URL does not match an approved authority domain are excluded. Returns explicit missing/unavailable states and is research, not legal advice. Example: {"jurisdiction": "Germany", "limit": 5}. Omit jurisdiction for a bounded global list.

jurisdiction.description: Optional country, jurisdiction or regulator name, for example "Germany", "UK" or "GGL".
